description.es: Has muerto, pero ese no es el final de esta historia. Creíste que hacías las cosas bien y mírate ahora; de la paz hiciste la guerra y de esta solo quedan tus remordimientos. Han venido a verte, buscan deshacer los entuertos, o eso piensan. Ahora no hay más remedio que observar en silencio el fruto de tus errores. Pero, ¿Hasta qué punto puedo declararte culpable?
description.en: You have died, but that is not the end of it. You thought you were on the good side of the story and look at you now; from peace you made war and from that, only your remorse remains. They have come to see you, they want to make amends, or so they think. Now there is no choice but to silently observe the consequences of your mistakes. Yet I wonder, to what extend I can truly declare you guilty?
